title: China State Council Prioritizes AI Application to Raise Productive Capacity
summary:
Premier Li Qiang led a government meeting that termed artificial intelligence a key driver for future national development. The State Council urged the prioritization of integrating AI into the real economy to accelerate the conversion of technology into productive capacity, specifically through improved supply-demand matching, joint research and development, and the expansion of pilot scenarios under the "AI+" initiative.

The administration emphasized the need to balance technological advancement with safety requirements. The council called for risk assessments and the implementation of tiered, category-based policies tailored to different industrial sectors to ensure a security bottom line for artificial intelligence deployment.
